safety: This build has NO real executor. All apply/undo/reset operations modify only SQLite simulation records. Never unlink/move/kill/control services/edit startup outside app-owned data.

api.GET /api/tasks: {tasks}; latest 15 durable tasks, current plan and event summaries
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}: {task}; status, goal, scopes, versioned plan, latest result, feedback, events, briefing, last_public_reply, investigation_notice and execution; plan/items and advice include host-owned provenance; previous advice identity independent of new plan
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/continue: {} -> {task,job_id}; continue a stopped or completed investigation
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/feedback: {message?,keep_ids?} -> {task,job_id}; save user intent, invalidate plan, investigate again
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/approve: {version,ids} -> {task,job_id}; explicit selection of exact plan, simulation apply/verify then stop with per-item results; later investigation requires explicit continue, no automatic model request during cleanup
api.POST /api/check: legacy compatibility only; no standalone UI entry; fixed known caches and partial inventories
api.GET /api/recommendations: {items:[original item + advice],groups,summary}; cached current model result or local rules, per-advice provenance; failed same-token reanalysis may retain previous valid model cache with analysis_notice
api.POST /api/recommendations/analyze: {} -> {items,groups,summary}; structured model advice if configured, rule fallback otherwise
api.POST /api/plan: {ids,action?,selection_mode?,snapshots?:{id:signature}} -> frozen plan; rejects stale provided signatures before approval
api.POST /api/duplicates: legacy explicit-catalog-files verifier {ids:<=100} -> {groups,warnings,bytes_read}; local SHA-256 with512MiB default read budget, no model or automatic deletion
api.POST /api/duplicates/scan: {paths:1..8 absolute local directories,max_entries?:1..100000(default25000),max_depth?:1..32(default16),max_bytes?:1..8589934592(default2147483648)} -> {job_id}; independent read-only size grouping then full SHA-256, cancel/progress through existing job routes; malformed request rejected synchronously, no readable roots causes failed job duplicate_scan_failed, some unavailable roots yields partial result. No LLM, main-catalog publication, score, plan or delete action
api.GET /api/files: {task_id?,offset?,limit?:1..100,query?,scope?,risk?,revision?,view?:all|suggestions|tree,parent_id?,kind?:all|file|directory|startup|service|process|software,rating?:all|high|low|neutral|unrated|skipped|no_advice|1..5} -> bounded observed-only page with assessment_revision,selection_revision,groups,coverage,breadcrumbs and per-row assessment/can_logical_select/can_auto_select/action/action_label/action_effect/action_unavailable_reason. Without task_id remains file/directory only; task_id restricts known/action scope, task suggestions only current-task direct explicit/skipped/no_advice records. Application tasks use suggestions/all flat, reject tree, no path inheritance; service details include state/state_label/start_mode, process details PID. Scope filter applies to files. Combined revision includes model assessment changes; stale revision409
api.GET /api/providers: {presets,protocols,checked_at}; documented presets, no live vendor guarantee
api.POST /api/tasks/analyze: {section,ids? OR query?/scope?/risk?/kind?,depth?,goal?} -> {task,job_id}; frozen analysis selection, no execution approval
api.POST /api/developer: {enabled?:bool,clear?:bool}; defaults off, captures subsequent requests only
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/facts: {offset?,limit?:1..20,ids?:comma-separated fact IDs up to12} -> {items,total,offset,limit,has_more}; historical observations with scope/source/time/recheck rule
api.GET /api/skills/{id}: {cursor?} -> flat versioned content, sha256, sources, budget, next_cursor; allowlisted resources only
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/direct-plan: {ids:1..500,action OR actions:{every id:action},snapshots?} -> {task,plan}; exactly one uniform action or complete per-ID actions map, identity/action/scope preflight and user-origin versioned plan with action_groups; approval remains separate existing approve route
api.POST /api/ui-preferences: allowlisted preference subset -> {preferences}; persisted separately from model settings/capture
api.GET /api/icon: {id,v?} -> local image bytes, X-Panxu-Icon-Status:ready|pending|fallback; existing catalog IDs only; no arbitrary path; bounded private memory cache and async extraction
api.POST /api/preferences: {custom_instructions:string} -> {preferences,settings}; merges only shared model-independent preference, preserves connection and key
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream: {stream,volatile:true}; bounded sanitized public cumulative reply, never tool arguments or approval
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream/events: SSE default data:{stream}; 4 concurrent connections,25s lifetime, snapshots/keepalive; resume by epoch+sequence
api.POST /api/updates/check: {} -> {status,current_version,latest_version,release_url,message,checked_at,source,code,cached}; explicit manual read-only release discovery; current private source not_configured, no network; never downloads or installs
api.POST /api/assessments/select: {task_id,category?:all|high|low|neutral|unrated|skipped|no_advice|1..5,mode?:manual|automatic,include_inherited?:bool,query?,scope?,risk?,kind?:all|file|directory|startup|service|process|software,cursor?,limit?:1..500,revision?,selection_revision?} -> selection_batch; full filtered task scope, kind participates in cursor fingerprint. File category roots cannot swallow other categories; application IDs stay distinct even with same executable path. Automatic only eligible current-source high ratings and actual available action; no model call or operation
api.POST /api/assessments/compile: {task_id,selected_ids,excluded_ids,snapshots:{every positive and negative id:signature},revision,selection_revision,cursor?,limit?:1..500} -> selection_batch plus logical,warnings; nearest path rule applies only to file/directory, applications compile exact IDs without path inheritance/dedup. <=5000 total explicit rules; current scope/identity/action checks, observed-only expansion and truthful partial counts; no scan/model/operation
api.POST /api/assessments/plan: {task_id,selected_ids,excluded_ids,snapshots,revision,selection_revision} -> {task,plan,picked_ids,selection,source_task_id}; recompile under shared state lock, freeze up to500 IDs/signatures/actions for separate approve, source-scoped user_direct plan, no LLM call. Supports one source task's files, background startup/service/process, or software scope; cannot mix unrelated domains. Legacy {ids:1..500,snapshots:{id:signature},revision,action:delete} stays files-only with stricter advice eligibility
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/execution: {} -> {execution:null|execution_state}; bounded current simulation batch status and per-item results, not task investigation progress
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/pause: {version:int} -> {execution}; cooperative pause between item commits, currently admitted atomic commit may finish; stale version409
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/resume: {version:int} -> {execution}; continue current paused simulation batch, not investigation reanalysis or replay after restart
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/cancel: {version:int} -> {execution}; stop uncommitted remaining items, retain committed receipts; cancellation is not undo

mutations: Require X-CSRF-Token from bootstrap. Errors are JSON {error,code}. Relative same-origin fetch only. Input limits apply.
summary: {total_items,visible_items,simulated_items,logical_bytes,simulated_bytes,process_memory_bytes,by_kind,source,mode}. Real disks separate; no simulated_bytes shown as actual freed space.
source: empty | local; normal startup contains no synthetic examples; fixtures require developer_fixtures=True at server creation
advice: {group:'recommended'|'personal'|'keep'|'review',title,purpose,reason,impact,auto_select,suggested_action,origin:'rule'|'model',needs_user_choice}; personal and unknown files never auto_select
plans: Risk protected cannot queue. Every entry freezes ID/signature/action; explicit kind/action allowlist and availability, never score/name/actions[0] inference. stop_service requires Running and changes no startup mode. Incomplete dirs disallowed; application entities never path-deduped. Existing simulated skip. Planned catalog revision bound, current identities/actions checked before execute. Plan action_groups count only its frozen batch. No arbitrary path actions or real executor.
privacy: No user file body read for LLM. Metadata only; send_paths false by default. Independent duplicate scan reads candidate bytes locally for SHA-256 but never sends them to a model. No real provider key expected in tests. LLM cannot execute or approve plans.
agent_task: statuses ready/investigating/awaiting_review/executing/needs_input/needs_model/paused/budget_exhausted/error/completed. Up to6 model requests and12 executed tools per user turn; normally4 investigation+2 reserved scoring/conclusion rounds, earlier finalization near budget. Model record_advice/propose_plan schemas cap6 items; host historical30 and manual500 remain separate. High-rating initialization is an editable draft, never approval; final selection determines targets. Protected/out-of-scope/unsupported identities and stale plans cannot bypass factual checks. Unknown score is not3 or permission. Tool text is untrusted.
action_runtime: simulation backend only. Per-item durable intent plus atomic overlay/receipt, status succeeded/failed/partial/cancelled/unverified. Recovery verifies receipts without blind replay. User undo is separately visible as current_state=undone. Actual reclaimed bytes always zero.
task_memory: Durable goal, choices, versioned plan, simulation receipts, up to300 historical facts/task with32MiB global fact-payload retention. Separate last_public_reply stores accepted public text<=8000 chars with completed_at,protocol,host provenance,truncated; not private continuation, model context or partial-stream success. Model connection change reconstructs fresh context. Request attempts/tools/work counted; missing provider token usage is unknown.
task_scan: ScanIndex durable name/metadata spool, stable keyset cursor; steps1..512, rows<=100000/scan. Interrupted unfinished enumeration replays with explicit work accounting; acquired rows retained. Whole-directory actions require separate current subtree validation. Investigation offers22 tool schemas; finalization offers record_advice/propose_plan/present_findings/ask_user, last finish-only phase present_findings/ask_user. discover_tools is help, not lazy schema loading.
guidance: 18 fixed bundled markdown resources, version1.2.0, each max32KiB; list_skills/read_skill provide bounded guidance with versions/fingerprints/official sources. Guidance is not current evidence or extra execution permission.
user_actions: Model questions have independent monotonic versions; answers/skip durable but not approval. Host direct-plan preflights current identity in task scope, then same approve/runtime; source, chosen IDs, results flow back. Legacy manual history only intersects task-known IDs for model awareness.
license: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; Required Notice copyright 2026 Liss. Scope original PanXu material; third-party components retain their licenses. Explicit user choice 2026-11-02.
developer_dock: Closed by default; settings entry and F12 toggle. Same bounded capture/view filters in right-side dock; mounted independently of current task view. No auto capture when opening.
appearance: Default follows system; explicit saved light/dark preserved; live media changes apply without restart.
read_only_evidence: collect_system_configuration(section=memory_power) observes memory/active vs configured pagefiles/power via fixed APIs and7 registry values; inspect_volume(scope_id) observes only existing task-scope volume capacity/recycle statistics. No root or action targets added; unknown/partial explicit.
icons: Private known-ID local icon extraction from existing executable resources, desktop registration or stock/type fallback; visible lazy requests, bounded queues/cache, no shell extensions/shortcut resolution or LLM transmission. Icons do not certify publisher or ownership.
developer_readability: Visible-role text and public communication by default, one closed auxiliary section per event for system/context/facts/skills/tools/metadata/raw sanitized JSON. Protocol-private content stays excluded.
model_streaming: Four native protocols with real SSE aggregation; public cumulative previews independent of developer capture; partial tools never executable; cancel/disconnect/budget fail closed. Defaults on, JSON fallback labelled; spring grapheme UI respects reduced motion. Save precedes fixed-data connection test and failed test never rolls back saved settings.
visual_hierarchy: Platform Chinese typography, six text roles, shared semantic status labels, independent light/dark surfaces; recommendation/source and simulated results do not claim actual operation success. Presentation only, no extra execution authority.
subtitle: AI 磁盘清理助手
author: Liss
advice_provenance: Optional host-owned {source:llm|local|unknown,provider,model,protocol,generated_at}; generated_at is timezone-aware UTC accepted output time, actual request snapshot, no endpoint/key. Missing history normalizes to unknown with null identities/time. Task advice and plan/item persist separately; matching old advice may appear as item.advice_provenance; user_direct uses local metadata and plan.origin. Changing settings never re-labels prior records.
assessment: Optional ordinal cleanup_rating:int1..5|null;3 neutral, missing never3. record_advice conclusion recommend|review|keep|skip|no_advice, inheritance:none|subtree(default none, directory content only). Shared monotonic host index bound to item signature; newer task intent blocks late older responses. Explicit child/barrier wins. Inherited score/context/provenance grants no action or authorization. Model-origin/automatic full-directory selection respects specific advisory and coverage barriers. Final user_direct may select low/skipped/unrated/stale-advice items or override task temporary keep/defer, but never signature staleness, policy protection, unsupported action, scope or incomplete whole-directory validation; containers with specific advisory barriers are expanded. Old per-task history retained.
timestamps: details.timestamps:created_at from st_birthtime_ns only,modified_at,accessed_at,observed_at timezone-aware ISO or null,scope entry_only; ordinary LLM metadata omits access, detailed shows caveat. ctime/signature semantics unchanged. Age, size, RSS are weak context, not deterministic score or actual-use history.
briefing: Optional propose_plan/present_findings briefing:{highlights?:string[<=3],cautions?:string[<=2],coverage?:string[<=2]}, each point<=160 chars. Summary remains propose_plan<=600/present_findings<=1000 chars whether briefing is present or absent; no hidden cross-field160-char rejection. Around80-char summary is style guidance only. Main-list preview<=160 is presentation, full accepted summary persists and remains readable in analysis details. Host-owned briefing_provenance binds accepted text to original task/plan version. Other schema,coverage,identity,scope and approval rules unchanged; no action authorization from presentation.
prompt_budget: Host-generated context and complete tool-result bodies use readable indented PanXu data v1 text after privacy filtering; preserve IDs, signatures, cursors, scopes, unknown/zero/false and locally shared identical row facts. User/assistant prose and private continuation are not rewritten. Native API envelopes,22 tool schemas and validated tool-call arguments retain protocol typing. Durable facts/choices/capabilities remain; bounded initial sample includes omitted counts/lookup. Report model-visible chars separately from HTTP bytes; heuristic estimates are not provider token usage.
selection_batch: {ids,snapshots,items:[{id,name,kind,path,signature,action,action_label,action_effect,category,assessment:{state,rating}}],action_groups:[{action,label,total,returned}],revision,catalog_revision,selection_revision,task_id,counts,groups,has_more,next_cursor,requires_batches,offset,limit,observed_only:true}; <=500 targets per response: file directory coalescing only, app exact IDs stay distinct. counts.total_targets/action_groups.total cover full selection; returned covers current batch, unlike plan.action_groups which describes only frozen plan. Rating groups include1..5/skipped/unrated/no_advice even zero. Cursor binds task intent/filter/kind/rules/revisions. <=5000 explicit IDs; whole-directory targets may represent many files, partial/unscanned/outside-task content never presumed selected/empty.
logical_selection: For files, selected_ids/excluded_ids are frozen positive/negative path rules, most-specific wins including child reselect. For applications, exact-ID selection/exclusion only; same exe/name never broadens selection. Every explicit positive/negative ID must exist in source action scope with current signature; available action is frozen and rechecked. Compile only known observations, file containers expand around exceptions/protection/coverage gaps. Temporary task holds may be manually overridden and counted, policy protection never. Separate plan approval and source result feedback remain.
execution_state: {task_id,plan_version,status:running|pausing|paused|cancelling|completed|cancelled|interrupted,revision,updated_at,total,processed,succeeded,failed,unverified,cancelled,pending,current,can_pause,can_resume,can_cancel,actual_reclaimed_bytes:0,backend:simulation,items}; per-item pending/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/unverified. Pause/cancel gates run between commits without waiting under app locks; committed receipts survive cancellation, process restart never blindly replays.
duplicate_scan: Independent job result {source:local_duplicate_scan,algorithm:sha256,status:completed|partial|cancelled,partial,result_truncated,roots,summary,groups,warnings,bytes_read,limits,read_only:true,llm_used:false,actual_reclaimed_bytes:0}. Summary {files_seen,scanned_entries,directory_count,candidate_files,checked_files,hashed_files,content_groups,hardlink_groups,total_groups,grouped_paths,returned_groups,returned_files,omitted_groups,omitted_group_items,skipped:{reason:count},entry_limit_reached,timed_out}; files_seen counts accepted metadata files, checked_files includes verified hardlink paths, hashed_files counts actual digest computations, grouped_paths counts group memberships. Max200 groups/2000 path entries; total/omitted refer to formed verified groups, not unscanned filesystem. Limits include max_seconds1200 cooperative deadline, not forced I/O timeout. Truncation/skip/limits/cancellation/change make partial; cancelled keeps earlier complete groups, not current unfinished size group. No main-inventory publication, rating or action permission.
duplicate_group: {group_id,type:content|hardlink,items,items_total,omitted_items,size_bytes,verified,verification:sha256|file_identity,sha256?}. File-size grouping precedes full SHA-256; no second bytewise comparison. Content hash match is strong practical evidence, not mathematical collision impossibility or a deletion recommendation. Hardlink paths share an entity, not independent copies; reclaimable space remains unknown. Protected/credential/project/reparse/cloud-placeholder files skipped, identities/metadata checked before open, on handle and after read. Local read budgets do not authorize hydration, model upload or real modification.
navigation: Contextual upper-left back for task analysis details and independent duplicate pages; main list prioritizes short summary,ratings and first important caution only. All highlights/remaining cautions/coverage stay on analysis page with full summary,provenance and public reply; process page retains scope/work/events and on-demand guidance/facts; adjustment page retains feedback draft. Single-layer file view/category controls reduce disclosure nesting, not all historical details widgets. Back retains task/selection and is not cancellation,undo or plan approval; necessary impact,source,protection and partial-state information remain accessible.
response_limits: Main-agent single source streaming.py: SSE wire<=16MiB,frames<=20000,event<=128KiB; native response<=2MiB UTF-8, normalized continuation-bearing object<=6MiB UTF-8; text field<=64000 chars, tool calls<=8 per response. Tool arguments parse to object and canonical ensure_ascii=False JSON<=128000 semantic chars, raw encoding<=12 times this; native/event caps still apply. Finite request generation budget remains3500 custom/ollama or8192 named presets; total stream deadline180s. Unicode escapes/astral must not be charged as duplicated ASCII-native response size. No partial call executes.
investigation_notice: Optional task DTO {code,at,recovered,recovery_attempted?,budget?:{boundary,observed:number|null,limit:number|null,signal?}}; safe allowlisted diagnostics only. At most one failed-output transition per user turn from response_budget/invalid_tool_arguments into persisted-facts finalization using remaining6/12 budget, no recollection or partial-call replay; second failure/exhausted rounds stop truthfully. recovered means accepted output, not complete coverage/cleanup. Explicit provider length/max_output_tokens/max_tokens/MAX_TOKENS maps response_budget generation_tokens, unknown usage stays null; arbitrary disconnect remains incomplete and is not auto-retried. Old response_budget traces cannot identify missing boundary; ASCII normalized invalid_response and plain-reply local-result misuse are independent fixes.
public_activity: Client subscription activity:{events:[{id,label,kind,at}],omitted} is volatile frontend-session memory, max8 tasks x32 public statuses and max4 shared live connections. Default last3; four-second reader-observation retention window can show up to8 recent entries, bounded scrolling/history review; immediate errors. This does not delay backend or guarantee capturing/showing each state for4s. at is browser observation time, not durable task event time. No thinking,args,credentials or execution authority. Last unsubscribe closes transport/clears current stream; same-session history may remain, restart persistence not promised. Separate from saved public replies,facts and execution receipts.
application_actions: file/directory delete; startup disable_startup; service stop_service only currently Running; process stop_process; software uninstall, each must be present in current actions. Stopping a service is not changing StartMode; disabling startup neither kills a process nor uninstalls software. Startup registration does not prove enabled status. Shared executable/name never establishes one object, action, ownership or safe recommendation.
advice_display: Analysed records show complete purpose/suggestion/reason/impact directly in labelled, visually separated areas, without preview truncation; provenance/technical detail remain on demand. Never-analysed lists show concise pending/local type explanation, never fabricated LLM advice. Analysed-unscored,plan-only,skipped,no_advice,stale remain distinct; missing score is not3 or proof of no prior analysis. Missing frozen action is pending operation, never assumed delete. PID/service state/start-mode/inapplicability are visible and checkbox labels distinguish same-name objects. Confirmation lists complete current-batch targets/frozen actions/impacts in scrollable content. Icon/color/score certify neither safety nor success.
product_mode_copy: Natural concrete action names in controls/confirmations/progress/history, without repeated simulation prefix; one global visible mode notice explains current simulation-only backend. Machine mode/receipt/protection/version rules unchanged, actual reclaimed bytes0. Product results describe internal recorded/verified/failed/cancelled/unverified state, never claim real stop/kill/uninstall/delete success. Never strip words from user filenames/program names, public model prose or raw receipts; no hidden real-execution switch.
operation_feedback: Results preserve historical succeeded plus separate current_state=undone and undone count. actions/undone_actions/action_results aggregate by frozen action; action_results has total,succeeded,failed,cancelled,unverified,undone. POST undo refreshes corresponding execution result and source cleanup_results/last_cleanup_result by execution_task_id+plan_version, without another model request. Older execution versions cannot borrow counts from a newer plan. Actual reclaimed bytes remain zero.
